title: We have released Neural Pixelate V2, our free Aseprite extension for cleaning up AI generated pixel art
author: black-magik-studios
selftext:
Last month we released Neural Pixelate, a 100% free. 100% offline Aseprite extension, to clean up AI generated "pixel art", giving it perfect blocks at 2x2-8x8 scales without ever changing the original dimensions of the image.

Since then we have been hard at work improving our algorithms. We are proud to announce v2 which beats our initial v1 release in every metric.

Notably v2 improves in color consistency from the input to pixelated image, no more unexpected color changes or tints. We also improved our mixel detection, allowing the model to output even crisper edges with less manual post processing work needed. As part of our commitment to always improve, development on v3 has already started.

If you want to try it out for yourself you can find it on our [itch](https://blackmagikstudios.itch.io/grimoire-neural-pixelate) page.  
The benchmark used is a fork Pixelbench available on the BlackMagikStudios pixelbench-expanded github repo.
